newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the banking system Wednesday via overnight system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokesman said.
The move was in line with market expectations.
At 1130 EST/1630 GMT, the time the Fed usually intervenes in the market, federal funds were quoted at 5-5/16 percent, above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target.
Analysts said they still see the possibility of a coupon pass operation on Wednesday.
